description: Source-only build of the whole Quran (owner decision 2026-11-26). Every chapter's Arabic text, word IDs and Urdu word-by-word meanings come from Quran.com; grammar from the Quranic Arabic Corpus. Chapters listed in `existingLessons` keep their published grammar layer and take only the Quran.com word meanings; every other chapter is built from the sources alone. `translations` are the Urdu ayah translations offered in Settings, in display order; the first is the default.

excludedTranslations.reason: Fi Zilal al-Qur'an: some ayahs embed commentary (tafsir), e.g. 26:224
